paragraphs.text: Pontotoc shoppers will find a familiar group of local businesses at Celebration Village in Tupelo this week. The Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street announcement names ten retailers taking part in the Oct. 21–24 event, which starts with a Wednesday evening preview before general shopping Thursday through Saturday.
The event is at Tupelo Furniture Market, Building Five, and its proceeds support Sanctuary Hospice House, according to WTVA’s original report and interview with the organizer.

The Chamber’s participant list includes The Rack Boutique, True Blue Boutique, Anna Jade Boutique, The Carousel Children’s Boutique and Ultra Violet Boutique. It also names The Red Door Gift Shop, City Mercantile Gifts, Decor & More, Ace & Co Boutique and Gifts, Pure Bliss Gifts & Boutique and Double B Boot Company.

Wednesday’s preview party runs from 6 to 9 p.m. WTVA reports that the $50 ticket includes early shopping and dinner. General public shopping begins Thursday, Oct. 22, and continues through Saturday, Oct. 24. The preview ticket price applies to that evening event; the report does not give a general-admission price.

For shoppers looking for a particular Pontotoc business, the Chamber directs people to the participating stores’ Facebook pages for booth numbers and operating hours. Its full notice and WTVA’s event report are linked below, along with our separate coverage of Saturday’s Pontotoc Nights event.
